skywhales.configuration.title: %s configuration
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.4782: How often, how many, and where (around the player) sky whales spawn.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.fdab:
Master switch for near-player whale spawning. When false, whales only appear via spawn
egg, /summon, or a server's own summoner scripts.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.9c08: Master switch for near-player whale spawning. When false, whales only appear via spawn
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.afbd: egg, /summon, or a server's own summoner scripts.
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.4d36:
How often (in ticks; 20 ticks = 1s) the spawner runs a spawn attempt for each eligible
player. Larger = whales appear less often. Cheap between runs (just a countdown).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.16b9: How often (in ticks; 20 ticks = 1s) the spawner runs a spawn attempt for each eligible
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.9e16: player. Larger = whales appear less often. Cheap between runs (just a countdown).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.236d:
Probability (0.0-1.0) that a given attempt (one per eligible player per interval) spawns
a whale. Combined with the interval this sets how quickly whales appear up to the cap.

aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.d7e7: The most whales allowed within 'nearbyWhaleRadius' of a player before the spawner stops
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b569: adding more — this is what keeps them 'around but not too many'. 0 disables spawning;
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b089:
Radius (blocks) the 'maxNearbyWhales' cap counts within, around the player. Keep this
>= immediateDespawnDistance so whales that linger (but haven't despawned yet) still count
toward the cap — otherwise slightly more than maxNearbyWhales can gather around a player.

aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.2c86:
When true, only spawn for players standing over an ocean biome (tag #minecraft:is_ocean).
Set false to let whales spawn around players anywhere (any biome, including over land).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.b1da: When true, only spawn for players standing over an ocean biome (tag #minecraft:is_ocean).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.96a6: Set false to let whales spawn around players anywhere (any biome, including over land).
aeroscapes_reimagine.config.literal.fd34:
When true, ALSO spawn for players out over the void — a column with no terrain/surface
below (e.g. flying over the abyss on a void / lifted-island world). This is additive to
the ocean rule above: with restrictToOceanBiome=true, whales then appear over ocean AND
over the void, but not over normal land. (If restrictToOceanBiome is false, spawning is
already allowed everywhere including the void, so this flag has no extra effect.)
